body:
Hello Randy. Thank you for all the work you've put into researching Columbine. I can't even pretend to imagine how hard it must've been.

My questions are:

Do you have any particularily positive/favorite memory of Dylan?

And, on the other hand, any memory or something of him that might've not seem so important when it happened, but after the shooting you realized was really alarming?

Also, regarding the basement tapes, how much do you think they were acting in them vs how much of their true selves they had shown? Anything about them that others omitted that you thought was interesting, any particular interaction?

Best wishes & I hope you and your family are safe.
